verdict.rationale: Fastmail has its own offline support help article. A community user confirms offline mail now works in both the web and mobile apps. The docs also describe offline behavior that resolves once you are back online (snoozed messages reappear after reconnecting). The evidence never shows searching or composing offline, or local changes syncing on reconnect. missing for 10: documented offline search, documented offline compose/send queue, explicit description of syncing local changes on reconnect, hands-on corroboration of the full read/search/write workflow.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: Offline mail is finally in both the web and mobile apps.
If you're offline when a snoozed message is scheduled to return to your Inbox, you will not see the snoozed message reappear until you're back online.
